Name: Void Effects
Author: OfficialRenny
Description:
This mod adds multiple effects to void items in your games. Some of these are:
[list]
[*]Void items constantly drain your health and stamina as long as you have a void item in your inventory.
[*]Consuming a food item of the void variety causes you to go into a coma for 2 to 5 days.
[*]More may be added soon.
[/list]Now this isn't all that bad, as Void items now are worth twice the amount they used to be! It's high risk for a high reward.


[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Requires at least v1.2.0 of SpaceCore.[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2696/]Works best with Void Ranch.[/url]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use
[/size][font=Courier New]togglevoid[font=Arial] in the SMAPI console to toggle the mod on/off.
If the mod is off, any items affected by price changes will continue to have those prices, anything spawned afterwards will have vanilla prices.
[/font][/font]
If the mod is turned on, all existing Void items continue having the same price, but they can still cause ill effects and any newly spawned items will have the new prices.

Vanilla Game Items Affected:
[list]
[*]Void Egg
[*]Void Mayonnaise
[*]Void Essence
[*]Void Salmon
[/list]
Items Affected with Void Ranch installed:
[list]
[*]Void Essence
[*]Void Salmon
[*]Egg (Both varieties)
[*]Large Egg (Both Varieties)
[*]Mayonnaise
[*]Duck Egg
[*]Duck Mayonnaise
[*]Rabbit's Foot
[*]Duck Feather
[*]Void Egg
[*]Void Mayonnaise
[*]Milk
[*]Large Milk
[*]Goat Milk
[*]Large Goat Milk
[*]Cheese
[*]Goat Cheese
[*]Wool
[*]Cloth
[/list]
After running a config.json will be created in the mod's folder, this will allow you to change the sale price of Void Items (Default: 2x
Vanilla price). The config file can also be used to change how large the decay is for holding void items (See 1.1.1 in the changelog).

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Intended for use on Stardew Valley 1.3+.
[*]Requires SMAPI 2.7.
[*]Works in single player. Everything but the coma effect should work in multiplayer, slightly nerfed the penalty for eating a void item in multiplayer.
[/list]
